question: Which permitted primary public sources give REBCO coated-conductor critical current versus field (worst-case or stated orientation) and temperature over roughly 8-20 T near 15-25 K, and a fusion REBCO cable or winding construction with its conversion from tape to cable and winding-pack current density (stabilizer, substrate, jacket, insulation, cooling, degradation), sufficient to compute winding-pack capability at a common lower field?
where_to_look: registered Molodyk et al. 2021 Sci. Rep. and magneto-angular fit source
Wimbush and Strickland public HTS critical-current database (Robinson Research Institute)
Senatore et al. field and temperature scaling of REBCO (Supercond. Sci. Technol.)
SPARC TFMC and VIPER cable open-access papers (Hartwig et al.)
EUROfusion/EPFL HTS fusion conductor papers, arXiv, OSTI
